metaDescription: Order custom pink badge ID holders for your team. Personalize with your logo. Fast bulk delivery from Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Pink badge ID holders offer a distinctive way to color-code security levels, designate special events, or support breast cancer awareness campaigns. Available in horizontal or vertical orientations, these holders can be customized with your logo or text through screen printing or debossing. Choose from retractable reels, lanyard attachments, or magnetic backings to suit your workplace needs. Bulk ordering ensures consistent branding across your entire organization.
